title: Auto restart
description: Automatically stop your server with a countdown and allow players to skip the restart with a command.
body:
AutoStop Minecraft Plugin
This is an automatic restart/stop plugin designed for Minecraft servers.

🚀 Features
Automatically counts down and shuts down the server.

Ideal for scheduled maintenance or automatic restart scripts.

Allows players to skip the restart manually.

🛠️ Development Environment
Language: Java 26

Core: Paper/Spigot API

Tool: Maven

📝 Usage
Place the compiled .jar file into the server's plugins folder.

Restart the server to load the plugin.

⌨️ Commands
/skiprestart: Skip the currently scheduled restart (Available to all players, allowing them to delay the restart during important activities).
